name: Fire
tagline: Fire your webhooks from your glasses
description: Tap a name on your Even G2 glasses and fire a preconfigured webhook — either an IFTTT applet or a raw HTTP request (method, URL, headers, body) to an endpoint you configure. Bring your own IFTTT Webhooks key; it is stored only on your phone (in the Even App), never shown on the glasses, and sent only to IFTTT. Anyone with that key can trigger any applet on your IFTTT account. Raw requests go only to the endpoints you enter. No accounts, no backend, no telemetry.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fires IFTTT webhook requests to maker.ifttt.com and Raw HTTP requests to endpoints the user enters in settings (not fixed at build time).
